description: Create a new fixed asset record for a tractor purchase. Navigate to the Fixed Assets section (Accounting > Fixed Assets). Create a new asset with the name 'John Deere 6120M'. Set the Gross Amount to 78,500.00 EUR. Configure the depreciation method as 'Linear' (Straight-line) starting on 2025-01-15 for a duration of 7 years (84 months). Select appropriate accounts for Asset (2154xx - Material/Tooling), Allocation (28154xx - Depreciation of material), and Expenses (68112xx - Depreciation charges). Save the record and ensure it appears in the list.
